canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, recursively Unicode-code-point-sorted object keys, arrays preserved, no spaces, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, trailing LF

relation_parser.offsets: Unicode code-point offsets plus raw locator; protected tokens are atomic
relation_parser.ambiguity_rule: same-distance competing subjects/objects, cue conflict, table cross-column relation or non-unique condition boundary is unknown; never guess

reader_task_path.path_rule: page_type selects exactly one ordered path; missing, duplicate, reordered or unknown stages fail closed
reader_task_path.reader_surface_rule: stage must be visible in Reader; Audit-only stage evidence cannot satisfy the path

embedding_route_descriptor.field_support_rule: title, question and page_type each require at least one support_ref; a support_ref must point to the current raw Block/Claim semantic frame or an authenticated CompanyBrain route observation, and every descriptor field must be supported by the field named in that ref
verification_algorithm: normalize descriptor text with Unicode NFC, trim and collapse only internal ASCII whitespace
recompute source/block/claim and selected closure hashes from the current ledger or authenticated observation
recompute support_sha256 from the normalized descriptor, ordered support_refs and closure identity
verify every title/question/page_type support_ref and reject any cross-source or stale locator
embedding_route_descriptor.failure_status: route_status=unknown; do not send an embedding request; do not produce KD_WIN

negative_cases.input: wrong page_type while path and hashes are closed
question has no support in the selected current Block/Claim
title is supported only by a different source closure

identity_binding.canonical_contract_sha256_rule: loader computes SHA-256 over this file's canonical bytes (UTF-8, recursive Unicode-code-point key sort, no spaces, trailing LF); the derived value is written into runtime/request/replay/receipt identity and is never stored inside this file
